brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Depth metaphor reads instantly: opacity and scale stratify recent vs archived notes with clear hierarchy
Restrained dark palette with single blue accent gives connection threads a luminous, signal-like quality
Typography is clean and consistent, with good size pairing between titles, body, and timestamps
dominant_weaknesses: Connection threads are sparse, inconsistent, and don't visibly tie endpoints to specific cards — the core metaphor underdelivers
Stats panel and legend feel like flat 2D UI bolted onto a spatial canvas, breaking native integration
No indication of motion, parallax, or 3D camera affordance in a static frame that promises spatial behavior
fix_priorities: Anchor connection threads precisely to card edges with varying weight/glow to express relationship strength
Introduce parallax, blur-on-depth, and subtle drift cues so spatial-ness is felt, not just inferred
Reconcile chrome (stats card, legend, FAB) with the spatial language — float them or recede them into the same z-system
Differentiate archived cards further with chromatic desaturation or fog so layers read at a glance
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral and reflective lead via the depth metaphor, but behavioral clarity lags because interactions and navigation affordances are invisible.
rationale.intent_fit: It gestures at the 3D-notes brief through opacity layering and threads, but the spatial system feels diagrammatic rather than inhabited.
